description: This PHP source file contains unit tests for the CountryService class in the OrangeHRM administrative plugin, specifically testing country and province retrieval functions.

classes.name: CountryServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the CountryService functionalities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating a new instance of CountryService.

methods.name: testGetCountryDao
methods.description: Verifies that getCountryDao returns an instance of CountryDao and that setCountryDao correctly updates the service.

methods.name: testSetCountryDao
methods.description: Tests the setter method for assigning a new CountryDao instance.

methods.name: testGetCountryList
methods.description: Ensures getCountryList returns the expected list of Country objects with correct attributes.

methods.name: testGetProvinceList
methods.description: Checks that getProvinceList returns the correct list of Province objects.

methods.name: testGetCountryByCountryName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Country object by name, including null case when country doesn't exist.

methods.name: testGetCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Country object by code, including null case for non-existent code.

methods.name: testGetProvinceByProvinceCode
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Province object by code, with handling for non-existent code.

methods.name: testGetCountryArray
methods.description: Verifies that getCountryArray returns a list of associative arrays each containing country info formatted for UI display.
